job.title: StreamServe: Adaptive Speculative Flows for Low-Latency Disaggregated LLM Serving
job.selection_reason: Combines disaggregated prefill/decode serving with adaptive speculative execution and metric-aware routing. The primary-source abstract reports evaluation on four A800 GPUs and large latency reductions versus tensor-parallel vLLM, making it a relevant candidate for the scheduling/disaggregation lineage despite the relatively small evaluation setup.
